name: source_audio
label: Source Audio
description: The audio to process. The result is saved as a new audio node linked to this one, which is left unchanged. Mono audio comes out as stereo, and everything is resampled to 48 kHz.

name: target_peak
label: Target Peak
description: The level the loudest sample is scaled to, as a fraction of full scale: 1.0 is the maximum, 0.5 is about -6 dB and 0.89 about -1 dB. Both channels are scaled together, so their balance is kept. This matches peaks, not perceived loudness, so a clip with sharp transients can still sound quieter. Above 1.0 the peaks clip.
